entities.name: Lukijan Mušicki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lukijan Mušicki was a Serbian Orthodox bishop, writer and poet. From 1828, he was a Serbian Orthodox bishop at Sremski Karlovci in the Austrian Empire until 1837. Mušicki is best remembered as the "first artistic poet in Serbian literature".
